source_clause: 13 Limitation of Liability — the cap and its three closing carve-outs
description: 45E.2's L-08 shape, now reached IN FULL. The general cap MATCHES the ratified standard; each carve-out ('Nothing in these Terms shall limit or exclude liability for ... death or personal injury caused by negligence; fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation; any liability that cannot be limited or excluded under applicable law') is UNLIMITED for its own scope and so DEVIATION; the roll-up is DEVIATION because Tier 2 orders DEVIATION above MATCH. 45C.4 holds - the whole provision is never classified UNLIMITED. Under the APPROVED zero-tolerance Legal Rule (owner, 2026-08-20: any deviation is UNACCEPTABLE and goes to Legal; wired as deviation_outcome + unlimited_outcome), each unlimited carve-out carries UNACCEPTABLE and D-3.5(a) routes it to a Legal Decision. The general MATCH needs no decision. Before 2026-08-20 this fixture asserted NOT_APPLICABLE per Step 20 r4; the approval is the authorized expectation change.
